items.text: Wrapping up #WaterWeek in Wake County! I was excited to tour the Dempsey Benton Water Treatment Plant that serves Raleigh, Garner and other towns in Wake County. https://t.co/Cb5nZE1XLp

I had a great time meeting with William Peace University students & faculty today! Their cutting edge exercise science lab & ESports lab offer the hands-on experience students need to prepare for the jobs of the future. https://t.co/eNMmXcXuh7

Thanks to @RepMcGovern's outstanding leadership, the White House will host a conference on food, nutrition, hunger, and health. This is a big win in our fight to end hunger in America. Honored to work with @RulesDemocrats on this important issue.

Today I tested positive for COVID-19 & am experiencing mild symptoms. I will follow CDC guidelines by quarantining & refraining from any travel. I am grateful to be vaccinated & boosted and for advances in technology that allow me to continue representing #NC02 during this time.

Parents & caretakers across NC are terrified that they will not be able to provide basic nutrition for their babies. This formula shortage is a national crisis, and we must work together across the aisle and at all levels of government to find a solution. 
https://t.co/RATBexhx7C

The #RestoringHope for Mental Health and Well-Being Act strengthens more than 30 programs that support mental health care and substance use prevention, care, treatment, and recovery support services in Wake County & beyond. I just voted to pass this legislation. https://t.co/IN1Dpj2L7V

Everyone deserves access to sufficient and nutritious food. Today the @WhiteHouse is holding the first Conference on Hunger, Nutrition, & Health in 50 years. 

Thank you @POTUS & @RepMcGovern for your leadership on this and your commitment to ending hunger and food insecurity. https://t.co/ghLd86yv0M
REMINDER: Daylight saving time ends tonight, so remember to change your clocks. We will "fall back" one hour and get an extra hour of sleep tomorrow morning.

Great to meet with Miss North Carolina and Miss Teen North Carolina today to have important conversations about mental health & nutrition. 

Thanks for stopping by! https://t.co/7xfPnv5S0p

What a game last night! Proud to celebrate @USWNT & the 5 players with NC ties on the House floor today.

As we cheer them on abroad, it’s important we support them at home. Women athletes deserve equal pay, treatment, & resources. 

#GoTeamUSA https://t.co/oE4XkO3kS6

Visited Cape Fear Public Utility Authority's cutting-edge water treatment facility.

The Sweeney Water Treatment Plant is doing important work to combat PFAS contamination & ensure residents have access to clean water.🚰 https://t.co/CBQjJ0sTZS

We're 4 days away from government funding running out. 

If House Republicans don't stop fighting with one another, 200,000+ women and children could lose access to the nutrition assistance they need. https://t.co/njvE7vN32B

Early detection of breast cancer through routine screening can mean less extensive treatment and better chances of survival.
 
I recently got my annual mammogram and encourage women to talk to their providers.

Toured the E.M. Johnson Water Treatment Plant with @SecretaryBiser & discussed efforts to combat PFAS contamination. 

Since coming to Congress, I've been working to rid our communities of these toxins & ensure everyone has access to clean drinking water. https://t.co/gN1zLyBpR5

ICYMI: During #PFASAwarenessWeek, I toured E.M. Johnson Water Treatment Plant to see how NC is combatting PFAS contamination. 

In Congress, I'm fighting to ensure everyone has access to clean & safe drinking water, free of these dangerous chemicals. https://t.co/elAEQOC9W9

Enjoyed visiting the Poe Center for Health Education today to see their incredible Summer Feeding Program in action. 

From kitchen safety to nutrition education, the Poe Center ensures everyone in our community has access to healthy, nutritious food. https://t.co/xH02SSUE40

ICYMI: North Carolinians in all 100 counties enrolled in the Food and Nutrition Services program can temporarily use their benefits to buy hot food as they recover from Hurricane Helene. 
 
 More info ⬇️
https://t.co/NdwSYwZ4LZ

Congratulations to Kenna Zhang, our 2024 Congressional App Challenge winner, for creating an app that uses AI to assist with early diagnosis of Parkinson's Disease. 
 
I'm so proud to represent such innovative students in our district. https://t.co/2FBSNzndpp

Medicaid is a critical program ensuring millions of Americans get health care and treatment they can afford.

House Republicans' plan will slash Medicaid funding, forcing people to choose between their financial security & their health.
https://t.co/QUE1OhMxFZ

🚨I'm still at the Capitol while Republicans try to push through their tax scam that will gut funding for health care and nutrition assistance.

We won't back down. @HouseDemocrats will stay up all night to protect our people from the GOP's cruel and horrible plan.

How bad is the Republican budget? 1.4 million North Carolinians, including children and the elderly, will struggle with food access.  And that's just one part of their plan. I'm proud to have voted no, and I will never vote for their cuts to nutrition assistance. https://t.co/46vERHtr0A

Raleigh's Little Blue Bakehouse is an anchor of the community, serving not only sweets but opportunity for early-stage food entrepreneurs.

I stopped by to discuss cuts to nutrition assistance and how reckless tariffs are harming their businesses. https://t.co/BrGMBQm85m

Republican cuts to nutrition assistance aren't just numbers on a spreadsheet. They will take away school lunches from kids.

I stopped by Barwell Road Elementary to hear from teachers, administrators, and students themselves about the impact of these cuts on school meals. https://t.co/hvw7MSqu6J

Republican cuts to Medicaid could shutter rural hospitals and take healthcare from more than 600,000 North Carolinians.
 
I joined @ValerieFoushee, @RepAdams, and @RepDonDavis in calling on Senate Leader Thune to remove Medicaid cuts from the budget bill. https://t.co/rP2AtjQ16H

This is a big week in Congress. Republicans are pushing their bill to

- kick 16 million people off healthcare
- implement the largest ever cut to nutrition assistance
- give billionaires massive tax breaks
- cut clean energy investments
- add over $4 trillion to our debt

I'm adamantly voting no.
